name: Tiki mug
note: The wide ceramic mug tiki drinks are served in, sized for a genuinely large pour over crushed ice rather than the single measure a rocks glass holds. Shape varies wildly by design — a carved idol, a skull, a barrel — but the working capacity across the style is consistent, and it is the capacity a fit check cares about.
iceDisplacementNote: Solid ice only, on the same tumbler ratios as the rocks glass family scaled to this capacity — a tiki mug is wide-bodied rather than tall and narrow, so it packs closer to a rocks glass than to a highball. Crushed is taken as 7% above cubed: loose crushed ice weighs about 593 to 640 kg per cubic metre against 917 for solid ice, roughly 65% solid, where loose cubes run about 61%.
